Be Honest

Why is your whole group still arguing about where to eat lunch?

Here is what most Uptown lunch spots cannot do. One counter at Maroon Market covers the whole table, because the flavors come from all over the world and land in one place. Dumplings for you, bao buns for them, noodles for the one who never decides until the last second. Nobody settles, nobody splits up, and the prices were on this page before you even stood up.

This is Maroon Market, a Global Street Food Experience inside Monarch Market in the heart of Uptown Charlotte. Find them on Instagram at @maroonmarket_global.
